verdicts.reason: The two are almost the same 160x600 skyscraper, and they share the same flaws. The headline breaks one or two words per line ('Make / the / longest / day / last') and crowds out the phone. The legal fine print is set nearly as large as the '25% off' line and runs four lines, pushed against the CTA and the bottom edge. The SOLSTICE logo is shrunk to an illegible speck. A is slightly worse: its sun icon is almost invisible, and its CTA button runs nearly edge to edge with no side margin. B keeps a slightly more visible logo mark and a CTA inset a little from the edges.
